sync.title: Sync
sync.intro: Time Clock presses, daily report saves and photos made with no signal are kept on this phone and sent automatically when signal returns. Each one keeps the time it was made.
sync.allSent: Everything from this phone has been sent.
sync.listLabel: Time clock presses on this phone
sync.otherAccount: {count} press(es) on this phone belong to someone else's account. They'll send when that person signs in here.
sync.howItWorks: Sending twice never records a press twice. If the office already fixed a time, a refused press can be removed from this list.
sync.badgeWaiting: {count} time clock press(es) waiting to send
sync.reportConflict: The report was changed on another phone. Open it and choose which copy to keep.
sync.reportRefused: The server didn't accept it. Open the report to check it.

twoStep.title: Enter your code
twoStep.requiredIntro: Office admins see pay and company records, so a password alone isn't enough. After your password, you'll also type a 6-digit code from an app on your phone. It takes about two minutes, once.
twoStep.optionalIntro: After your password, you'll also type a 6-digit code from an app on your phone.
twoStep.step1: Install the free Google Authenticator app on your phone (App Store or Google Play). Microsoft Authenticator works too.
twoStep.step2: Tap "Start setup" below, then in the app tap + → Scan a QR code and point it at the square code (or tap "Open in my authenticator app" if you're on your phone).
twoStep.step3: Type the 6-digit code the app shows next to Petra Field Ops.
twoStep.scan: In Google Authenticator: tap +, then Scan a QR code, and point the camera at this square.
twoStep.qrAlt: QR code to add Petra Field Ops to your authenticator app
twoStep.openOnPhone: On this phone? Open in my authenticator app
twoStep.typeKey: Can't scan? Type this key instead
twoStep.thenCode: Then type the 6-digit code it shows.
twoStep.verifyIntro: Open Google Authenticator (or the authenticator app you set up) and type the 6-digit code next to Petra Field Ops.
twoStep.wrongCode: That code didn't work. Codes change every 30 seconds — type the one showing now.
twoStep.setupFailed: Setup didn't start. Check your signal and try again.
twoStep.tooManyTries: Too many tries. Wait 5 minutes, then type the code showing at that time.

closeout.title: Job closeout package
closeout.neverSubmitted: Daily reports started but never submitted (not included): {list}.
closeout.tooManyPhotos: Only the first {max} photos are included.
closeout.help: One PDF with the work order, every daily report, QC readings, issues and all photos. Best once the job is finished and its reports are accepted. Big jobs can take a minute.
